scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend run db:generate
scripts.db:push: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma db push
scripts.seed: npm --prefix backend exec -- prisma db seed
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend run test && npm --prefix backend run test:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix backend run test:cov && npm --prefix frontend run test:coverage
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.prebuild: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
